Spicy Sausage Stir-Fry
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 11:33pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 pounds smoked sausage or kielbasa, sliced
1 lg. green pepper, chopped
1 lg. onion, chopped
2 cans Campbell's spicy tomato soup, undiluted
1 1/2 teaspoons chili pepper
1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder
Red pepper, to taste (optional)

Preparation

1 Saute sausage in skillet until done. Add remaining ingredients and simmer about 10 minutes. Serve over rice.
